mcp.title: AI integration
mcp.description: Connect external AI clients to this app through MCP.
mcp.watchHint: AI can watch up to three live rooms in the background. A session ends when the room goes offline, you stop it, or it reaches this time limit. Collected danmaku remains available.
mcp.bufferHint: The AI client sets the buffer size for each session. The default is 20,000 messages. Unlimited removes the time limit. A session still ends when the stream ends.
mcp.memoryHint: AI can maintain memory after summarizing. Review or edit it here. Room memory is keyed by room ID, and global memory applies to all rooms. Each scope holds up to 8,000 characters.
mcp.transport: Streamable HTTP on local port 23332. An access token is generated on startup.
mcp.resetWarning: . Resetting immediately invalidates the previous token.
mcp.clientHint: Paste into the MCP configuration in Claude Code, Cursor, or Cline.
mcp.audit: The available tools and their calls are recorded in
mcp.auditHint: in the app log directory. Open Settings → About → Log folder to view it.
mcp.rules: These rules apply to AI tool calls over MCP. Read-only tools run in every mode.
mcp.fullWarning: Full access allows paid actions, including gifts, without confirmation. Use trusted clients only.
